author: King_FTW
body:
Hello,

I am King_FTW. As you guys may know or may not know. I am building an HungerGames map (HG) with Awesomerp. I asked some people to get a look and fly around and get there opinion so now i am asking to all of you guys what you guys think. There will be 2 links 1 with 15% done and 1 with 30% done. I should recommend you to watch the first one and then the second one. They are with and without shaders

15%: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=31yxxaWKsQU
30%: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dc4LjIsP5KM

Thanx for feedback

King_FTW & Awesomerp
